question: KIGK is related to JHFJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JHFJ is related to IGEI. To which of the following is SQOS related, following the same logic?
solution:
L [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc2a46d8760cb2dc4f79bf4ce64d91a393e78a1615f9a1a09e678c826c44299.png]

For, KIGK → JHFJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dac04e7f25b0c52bc7d1938525ad00155c9e5dadd784c10070ad5794e4adb41.png] 

For, JHFJ → IGEI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d21d56819da61dd3305d3886b523f286019673720df91a0f16d78675a9e6d9e3.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abb5a10067c5a495a8f86e0edaaf3d5af0be2f6f3d74df290854cbeee53ef38e.png] 

So, SQOS → RPNR

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
